note: Independent re-audit against RFC 6396 Section 4.2 ('The TABLE_DUMP Type does not permit 4-byte Peer AS numbers, nor does it allow the AFI of the peer IP to differ from the AFI of the Prefix field.  The TABLE_DUMP_V2 Type MUST be used in these situations.') at HEAD. writeTableDumpV2 and writePeerIndexTable (internal/plugins/mrt/dump.go) stamp mrtfmt.TypeTableDumpV2 (13) on every record and encode every peer with PeerAS4 (plus PeerIPv6 for IPv6 peers); no production writer in internal/plugins/mrt or internal/mrt emits TypeTableDump (12). TestDumpV2PeerWidthAndPrefixFamily drives writeTableDumpV2 across all 8 peer-AFI x prefix-AFI x 2/4-byte-AS combinations, failing on any non-TABLE_DUMP_V2 header and pinning PIT peer type/ASN/IP/BGPID and RIB prefix/attributes; TestRibSubtype supplements subtype mapping. Single-polarity annotation holds (no Ze path emits TABLE_DUMP to reject; minor stale line refs in annotation/comment do not affect the proof).
